    AI Overview
    U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) is the largest federal law enforcement agency under the Department of Homeland Security, responsible for securing U.S. borders, regulating international trade, and facilitating travel. CBP officers and agents, numbering over 60,000, prevent illegal entry, drug smuggling, and agriculture pests at ports of entry. 
    Key details about CBP: 
    • Core Mission: Secure U.S. borders against terrorists/weapons, enforce customs/immigration laws, and manage trade.
    • Structure: Comprised of the Office of Field Operations (ports of entry), U.S. Border Patrol (between ports), and Air and Marine Operations.
    • Role in Travel: Inspects over a million travelers daily and manages programs like Preclearance at 15 international locations.
    • Contact/Info: Information is available via {Link: help.cbp.gov https://www.cbp.gov/travel/international-visitors/applying-admission-united-states} or by calling 877-CBP-5511. 
    The agency was founded in 2003, bringing together agriculture specialists, customs officers, and border patrol agents.

    The Senate voted early Friday morning to fund most of the Homeland Security Department — excluding Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) and Customs and Border Protection (CBP) — ending a bitter funding impasse that began Feb. 14. The measure was approved by voice vote at 2:19am ET in a nearly empty Senate chamber after weeks of negotiations over potential reforms to immigration enforcement operations that Democrats had demanded following the killings of two American citizens in Minneapolis by federal immigration agents. Lawmakers ultimately failed to reach an agreement, leaving funding for ICE and CBP to be addressed through the budget reconciliation process, where Republicans are expected to pursue a party-line vote. Republicans are also likely to try to attach additional measures to a reconciliation bill — which can bypass the Senate’s 60-vote filibuster — including the SAVE America Act, the GOP elections bill that President Trump has demanded.
